speaker_role: current admissions officer, Assistant Director of Admission at Northeastern University
commercial_incentive: ILUMIN Education (an educational consulting company) hosts and promotes its own services around the webinar; the Northeastern officer's answers themselves are not sales-driven
key_insights: Northeastern doesn't require a supplemental 'Why us' essay, believing the Common App main essay already reveals fit; students needn't rewrite that essay solely for Northeastern
Strong essays typically walk through a specific project/action the student took, are heavily proofread, and stay centered on the applicant even when discussing a mentor figure
Northeastern is test-optional with a reported submitter mid-range of roughly 1470-1520 SAT and does not infer anything negative from missing scores
Early decision is described as the strongest demonstrated-interest signal Northeastern tracks; Northeastern offers early financial aid reviews for ED applicants before they commit

Northeastern's 'pathway' options (Boston campus, N.U.in first-semester-abroad, Global Scholars at Oakland/London) are separate admissions decisions evaluated for different qualities, not backups for one another
Combined majors (e.g. CS + Theater) differ from double majors: roughly a third of coursework in each subject plus a connecting curriculum, versus two fully separate programs
Co-op (paid, structured six-month work terms) is optional except for business majors, who must complete at least one; about 90% of students do at least one and about 80% of co-ops are paid
specific_numbers_or_facts: Northeastern received about 92,000 applications that cycle, up 15,000 from the prior year (per Olivia Harris)
Test-optional submitter mid-range cited as roughly 1470-1520 SAT (per Olivia Harris)
About a third of the incoming class is admitted through pathway programs (per Olivia Harris)
Majors must be declared by the end of sophomore year (per Olivia Harris)
Merit aid is generally awarded within roughly the top 10-15% of the applicant pool (per Olivia Harris)
notable_or_distinctive: Unusually granular explanation of Northeastern's multi-campus/pathway admission system (N.U.in, Global Scholars, Oakland/Mills, London), including how each path is separately evaluated and combined.
reliability_notes: Reflects one officer's account of her institution's current-year policies, some explicitly flagged as new/evolving (e.g. newly launched Oakland/London degree programs) and thus subject to change; long live Q&A with occasional caption garbling.
